column1: # onprem-metrics eol/assets.tsv (Day 25): what in this lab has a support end,
# a licence expiry or a hardware end-of-support, and where that date comes
# from. One row per (asset, component, milestone). Tab separated.
#   asset       the thing, named as the rest of the series names it
#   component   what has the lifecycle: os, firmware, hardware, runtime, licence
#   kind        os | firmware | hardware | runtime | licence
#   date        YYYY-MM-DD, or ? when not published / not yet looked up
#   basis       vendor    the vendor published this date
#               estimate  derived (e.g. a distro's base OS), say how in note
#               licence   read live from the device (eol-textfile.py --fortigate)
#               unknown   nobody has published one yet; the row is a reminder
#   source      URL the date was read from
#   note        free text; "待查" marks what is still to be confirmed on site
# Every ? becomes asset_eol_unknown{...} 1 so the gap is visible in Grafana
# instead of in someone's memory. Dates are checked against endoflife.date
